headline: Full /arc: restored E2E to green, killed the /studio-pulse/ CLS 95.7%, hardened the orphan gate to blocking, and root-fixed the Forge-Window phantom-suppressor divergence.

items.title: E2E compliance job restored to GREEN
items.insight: Root-caused a ~2-day CI red to a generated-layer strand (S275 added OG images without regenerating lqip-map; hourly [skip ci] feed crons stranded the derived layer). Resynced coverage-preserving; verified CI success.
items.evidence: gh run: E2E Test Suite success on bb25e7fd; build:check 195/195

items.title: /studio-pulse/ CLS 1.0355 -> 0.0446 (95.7%)
items.insight: vault-kinesis filled a ~150px SVG box post-paint (owned ~0.80 of the shift). Static #vs-vault-kinesis reserved mount + svg aspect-ratio in critical CSS. Probe-verified before/after.

items.title: All 27 orphan scripts resolved + gate flipped to blocking
items.insight: 2 deleted, 3 wired as live gates, 22 allowlisted-with-rationale; --warn-only -> --check so future stranded scripts hard-fail CI.

items.title: Forge-Window phantom leak root-fixed + shared decisions-corpus lib
items.insight: Suppressor read only live DECISIONS.md while its validator read archives -> silently inert after rotate-ledger sharded the superseding decision. Fixed to read archives; extracted shared readDecisionsCorpus so validator and suppressor can never diverge again.
items.evidence: scripts/lib/decisions-corpus.mjs; Forge Window suppressed in GENIUS_LIST.md

followUps: Homepage LCP measured pass: 47KB inline-CSS split (FOUC-safe, throttled before/after Lighthouse) to clear the route-tier floor honestly (floor NOT lowered).
/changelog/ + /games/ CLS via a build-time SSR generator (shared renderer + drift gate).
CI CLS-regression gate: probe-cls-bisect on key routes, fail if buffered CLS > 0.1.
blockers: Worker redeploy founder-gated: CF_WORKER_API_TOKEN lacks R2 Storage:Edit + User Details:Read + Memberships:Read (re-verified /user 403 on live token).
Lighthouse route-tier red (HONEST): homepage / 0.74 vs 0.76 floor; the deferred LCP pass, not a lowered floor (CANON-031).
